tl: Tl is a soft grey malleable metallic element that resembles tin but discolors on exposure to air.
Tl means the same as thallium or atomic number 81.
tlc: TLC is considerate and solicitous care.
For example: "Young children need lots of TLC."
TLC means the same as tender loving care.
tlingit: Tlingit is a member of a seafaring group of North American Indians living in southern Alaska.
Tlingit can also mean the Na-Dene language spoken by the Tlingit.
